release_read.basis: Adj EPS $1.76 against $1.44 (Nasdaq) / ~$1.52 (Benzinga) and an FY27 adj EPS guide raised to $6.50-6.70 from $6.00-6.35, well above the $6.31-6.34 street, drive it up; revenue $2.78B (-3.9%, a slight miss on ~$2.82B), Civil -15%, and a revenue guide whose midpoint did not move even with Ultra rolled in (an implied organic cut) plus the +8.8% run-up cap it well inside the 6.89% implied move.

release.headline: Booz Allen Q2 FY27: Profitability above expectations driven by strong operational execution

vs_bar.consensus_source: https://it.benzinga.com/quote/BAH/earnings-forecasts (snippet_only, via the stage E-P hunt; a second snippet gave 2.906, so the bar is disputed)
Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 6 estimates); Benzinga snippet ~1.52 gives +15.8%

key_line.metric: FY27 guidance with Ultra rolled in
key_line.detail: Revenue $11.3-11.6B (was $11.2-11.7B; midpoint unchanged at $11.45B although Ultra closed 2026-08-24, so organic revenue is implicitly lower); adj EBITDA $1,260-1,290M (was $1,240-1,290M); adj EPS $6.50-6.70 (was $6.00-6.35); FCF $850-925M (was $825-925M). Q2 book-to-bill 1.5x (1.7x a year ago), backlog $40.9B (+1.9%), headcount 31,000 (about flat sequentially), Civil & Commercial $702M (-15%), National Security $2,076M (+0.6%).

guidance.detail: EPS guide raised ~6% at the midpoint and above the street; EBITDA low end up; revenue range narrowed around an unchanged midpoint despite the acquisition roll-in, which is the weak spot the thesis did not expect.

call.detail: The call was at 08:00 ET and is over before the open; its content was not read. The pre-market ran to a high of 82.54 and sagged back to about 79 by the last print at 08:55, which fits a call that took some of the release's shine off (revenue/organic, Civil), but that is an inference from the tape, not from the transcript.

public_reaction.summary: One search for this morning's analyst actions and price-move headlines returned only older quarters (July 2026 and earlier); nothing dated 2026-10-23 was found.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 79.55 (+1.25%) against a 78.57 close; last print 78.99 (+0.54%) at 08:55, 29 prints and 5 in the last 30 minutes, stale_at_open true. Range 78.00-82.54: an early run to +5.1% that gave nearly all of it back, likely across the 08:00 call. My frozen read (+3.0%) sits above the pre-market, so by the release alone the market has priced less than it supports, but the post-call sag is the market disagreeing with that, and a stale tape makes the open uncertain. SPY -0.4%, IWM -0.6% pre-market.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a scheduled guide raise with Ultra rolled in; the EPS guide was raised well above the street and EPS beat, but the revenue raise the thesis expected did not come (midpoint flat), so the confirmation is on earnings, not on the top line.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is stale (last print 08:55) and has already round-tripped from +5% to about +1%, so the open is uncertain in level but the sag has already happened rather than being still to come; a small gap with a clear EPS/guide beat leaves less to fade, and a bmo name with a strong EPS raise tends to keep repricing.

recommendation.limit_basis: About +2.8% on the 78.57 close, close to the frozen release read (+3.0%), well inside the pre-market range (high 82.54, which the stock already traded this morning) and about 40% of the 6.89% implied move; unfilled, the position goes at the close.
recommendation.reason: De winst per aandeel en de winstverwachting voor het jaar zijn duidelijk beter dan verwacht, maar de omzet is iets zwakker en de koers zakte voorbeurs al terug van ruim +5% naar ongeveer +1%. We zetten een verkooporder op 80,75 dollar: als de markt het goede winstnieuws in de loop van de dag alsnog oppakt, verkopen we daar; anders gaat de positie bij het slot weg.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers vóór 09:30 verder wegzakt onder 78 dollar (onder het slot van gisteren), dan is direct verkopen bij de opening beter.
